title: Maharani The Queen
excerpt: The first grand Indian beauty and dance pageant in history, taking place in Kyiv on June 6–7, 2026. “Maharani” is an international premium platform celebrating confidence, individuality, and talent.

title: 12th International Day of Yoga in Kyiv
excerpt: Join the Embassy of India in Ukraine for an open-air yoga celebration in Kyiv. Admission is free, with refreshments after the event.

title: Free Stop the Bleed Training
excerpt: Learn to recognize life-threatening bleeding, use a tourniquet, pack a wound, and apply a pressure dressing. Participation is free; registration is required.
